thread:
Maria L.: heads-up — since ~08:50 UTC we've had a spike of GPU node provisioning failures in eu-west. about 30–50% of new nodes fail to attach the KMS keystore with a 403/egress-denied error. this coincided with the new egress lockdown rules that were applied to the worker subnet group.

Ashwin P.: seeing the same in the autoscaler logs. nodes eventually retry but retry storms are increasing launch cost. stacktrace excerpt: `attach-keystore failed: 403 Forbidden (egress policy)`. also noticed missing audit events for some keystore ops in the last 20m.

sre-bot: ALERT: vm-pool-eu-west provisioning error rate > 25% (5m avg). repro id: r-evg-2025-03.

Lev (oncall): can we confirm which egress hosts/IPs the keystore talks to? if the firewall blocked an IP range we can add allow rules quickly or route keystore traffic over the private link.

Maria L.: Keystore endpoint is kms-eu.internal.redwood-inference.net (resolves to 10.12.34.56 via privatelink). But the keystore service also hits cloud-kms.googleapis.com for key unwrap (third-party). The new NACLs/firewall rules were pretty strict and I see `DENY tcp 443 -> cloud-kms.googleapis.com` in the flow logs.

Nicole S.: I rolled the egress-policy change at 08:48 (infra PR #4521). That policy locked outbound to only https://vault.redwood/* and privatelink CIDRs. I didn't realize the keystore does outbound to cloud-kms. my bad — opening rollback.

Ashwin P.: short-term mitigation: 1) relax egress for control-plane nodes to allow cloud-kms.googleapis.com on 443, or 2) update keystore to use our internal KMS proxy (if we can flip it). Either needs a quick policy tweak.

Maria L.: also seeing duplicate retries from the provisioning controller. recommends lowering retry attempts and increasing backoff to avoid cost spike. current config: `retries: 8, backoff_ms: 200`. propose `retries: 3, backoff_ms: 2000` until the egress fix lands.

Lev (oncall): I'll rollback the egress rule now to restore baseline. if anyone objects call it out in 30s.

Nicole S.: no objections. I'm reverting PR #4521 and will monitor.

deploy-bot: Revert PR #4521 deployed to infra (job id: deploy-7789).

Ashwin P.: after rollback, check node bootstrap and keystore attach logs:
```
# on a failed node (journalctl -u rd-keystore)
Mar 15 09:02:13 node-aws-44 rd-keystore[2119]: attach request -> cloud-kms.googleapis.com:443
Mar 15 09:02:13 node-aws-44 rd-keystore[2119]: http error 403 egress denied
Mar 15 09:02:14 node-aws-44 rd-keystore[2119]: retrying (1/3)
```

Maria L.: confirmed: after the revert new nodes start attaching successfully. provisioning error rate dropped to <2% in the last 3m. audit logs for keystore ops are back-filling but we did lose visibility for ~17 minutes.

Nicole S.: I'm opening infra-ticket INFRA-1892: "Egress policy: add explicit allow for cloud-kms and documented whitelist for keystore flows". Assigning to Ashwin to add rules and to Maria for validation.

Ashwin P.: I'll add a more targeted allow rule (FQDN cloud-kms.googleapis.com + privatelink prefixes) and add a canary pool to validate. plan: 1) update security-groups/NACLs (no broad reverts), 2) patch provisioning backoff config, 3) run 10-node canary for 30m.

Maria L.: to avoid recurrence we should also add an automated smoke test that boots a node and verifies keystore attach and audit event within 2 min after deployment (flag: infra.smoke.keystore). I'll draft a PR for that.

sre-bot: ACTIONS: INFRA-1892 created; rollback performed; monitor set to vm-pool-eu-west error rate.

Lev (oncall): postmortem note — policy change should require verified dependency matrix for outbound services. adding checklist item to CHANGESET template: `requires_dependency_signoff: kms|keystore|audit`.

Nicole S.: summary for execs: short outage in eu-west provisioning for ~17m due to overly strict egress rule. no customer data exposed. cost impact: a small transient increase due to retries (estimate ~<$1k). mitigation: revert + targeted allow + retry tuning. follow-ups: INFRA-1892 + smoke test + changelog checklist.

Maria L.: thanks all. I'll push the validation PR and monitor for the next 2 hours. ping me if you see anomaly. :thumbsup:
